log_transformed_moments.transformation_effect: Log-transformation substantially reduced skewness from 3.26 to -1.29 and excess kurtosis from 21.49 to 1.94.

shapiro_wilk_sample.null_hypothesis: Sample is drawn from normal distribution

conclusion: The null hypothesis of marginal normality is decisively rejected across all formal tests (p < 0.0001), reflecting strong positive skewness (3.26) and heavy leptokurtic tails (21.49) driven by holiday surges. Rejecting unconditional normality does not, by itself, prove that non-linear or tree ensembles are superior to linear models (since linear models do not require normally distributed targets to yield unbiased estimates under Gauss-Markov). However, it indicates substantial distributional asymmetry and potential heteroskedasticity. The scientific justification for model selection must therefore be established through empirical out-of-time validation metrics (WAPE, MAE) and post-hoc residual diagnostics.
